Win round three of [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]].
==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Defeat your third round opponent in Magni the Bison's tournament.

===Reward===
:''No quest reward''
*You gain 15 [[Norn Reputation Point]]s for killing your foe (unless Norn rank 8 or above)
*You gain a quest reward after beating all 6 rounds, see [[Final Round: Fight!]] (first time completion) or [[Final Round, Championship Edition: Fight!]] (for repeated victories)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Magni the Bison
:''"'''[Solo Quest]''' My '''tournament''' is filled with weaklings and cowards! Those entered in the '''third round''' may claim they are skilled, but the scrawniest [[Norn]] child could beat them all! If you wish to prove me wrong, do it with deeds! No more words. Fight!"''

===Intermediate dialogue===
:(The dialogue depends on which opponent you are facing. See [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for the dialogue and quotes.)

==Notes==
*Round three opponents may be [[Cynn]], [[Danika]] (with [[Brutus]] and [[Sheena]]), [[Lukas]], [[Panaku]], [[Warmaster Tydus]], or [[Zho]] with [[Onyx]]. Please refer to [[the Norn Fighting Tournament]] article for details on their skill sets.
*This quest is automatically accepted upon completing the preceding quest (that is, winning the round 2 of the tournament). It is also automatically completed upon defeating the round 3 opponent and the follow-up quest [[Round 4: Fight!]] is automatically accepted.
